segments.t: Walking into the kitchen while Viktor Petrovich steps away, Valdemar Barani senses the cooks' hostility and offers to tell them his side of what really happened in Paris. He confesses that when he was young, Viktor Petrovich was not merely his teacher, but a culinary god to him—until Barinov's gambling and drinking spiraled out of control.
